'''Emara''' is an [[Accepted]] who is part of the [[Salidar Aes Sedai]]. She is from [[Illian]].

== Appearance ==
She is lean and tiny with gray eyes and a quick grin. She has a high-pitched voice.

==Strength and Abilities==
Emara has a [[One Power]] strength of {{opsl|36}}, making her [[Strength in the One Power among Aes Sedai|weak]] for an Aes Sedai. She would be unable to [[Travel]] without linking with another sister.

== Activities ==
She was born in [[968 NE]], she went to the White Tower in [[985 NE]]. After spending nine years as a novice she was raised Accepted in [[994 NE]].  

She did not like Siuan and Leane. She is one of the Accepted in Salidar.

She is punished for taunting [[Siuan Sanche]] and [[Leane Sharif]] about their [[Stilling]]; but aside from that she was pleasant.

She lives in the same house as [[Nynaeve al'Meara]] and [[Elayne Trakand]], and forced to share a bed with fellow Accepted [[Ronelle]] and serving women [[Satina]] and [[Mulinda]]. She did not resent any of her companions in the house. 

When a [[Bubble of evil]] erupts in Salidar, she is nearly strangled by a sheet. She is saved, but is too ill to join the circles. 

She is discourteous to [[Theodrin Dabei]], as she does not approve of her raising by decree. She is severely reprimanded for it by [[Egwene al'Vere]]. She delivers a message from [[Lelaine Akashi]], who wishes to meet with Egwene.
